Steeline is an Australian-owned network of independent manufacturers and suppliers specialising in roll-formed steel building products. Established in 1991, we are the nation’s only buying group dedicated to producing and distributing high-quality roofing, guttering, fencing, and shed solutions. Our members use genuine BlueScope materials, including Colorbond® steel for external finishes and Zincalume® and Galvaspan® steels for structural components, ensuring durability and compliance with Australian building standards. Steeline supplies builders, trades, and homeowners across Australia.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHNICAL TECHNICIAN to join and bring their expertise to our dedicated professional team based in Berrimah, Northern Territory

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Conduct regular inspections, tests, and maintenance of machinery and equipment to ensure optimal operation performance
Diagnose equipment failures, analyse performance, and implement efficient solutions to machine breakdowns and minimise downtime
Perform routine maintenance on machines, such as cleaning, lubricating, and checking performance, to prevent breakdowns
Prepare drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Install, remove, inspect, and repair mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment
Perform major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors
Disassemble, assemble, observe, repair, test, collect data and prepare reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance
Maintain non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials
Optimise mechanical efficiency by adjusting machinery and equipment settings
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation
Supports improvement projects
Fabricate and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment
Control downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures
Install and commission new equipment as directed
Communicate with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, parts usage, and system conditions in a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Skilled in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, pneumatics, and precision measuring instruments
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills and experiences we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients

Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys

Enjoy competitive rates, frequent staff perks and a positive workplace culture.

result.description:
Full-Time Timber Yard Labourers – Permanent Positions (10 Positions)

Location: South Brisbane, QLD
Commencement: August 2026
Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking 10 reliable and motivated Full-Time Timber Yard Labourers to join a busy timber manufacturing and pallet processing operation based in South Brisbane.

These are permanent full-time positions offering consistent employment within an established production environment. Successful applicants will receive comprehensive training, a full site induction and ongoing support from experienced supervisors.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking long-term employment in the timber manufacturing industry with opportunities to develop skills and progress within the business.

Key Duties

Successful applicants will be responsible for a variety of timber yard and production duties, including:

Repairing damaged timber pallets using hand and power tools.
Assembling new timber pallets to production specifications.
Inspecting pallets and timber products to ensure quality standards are met.
Stacking, sorting, packing and preparing pallets for storage and dispatch.
Loading and unloading timber products and pallets.
Assisting with general timber yard operations.
Supporting production staff with manufacturing activities.
Maintaining a clean, safe and organised workplace.
Following all workplace health and safety procedures.
Performing repetitive manual handling and lifting throughout the shift.
Completing other duties as directed by supervisors.
Essential Selection Criteria

Applicants should demonstrate:

Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic.
Ability to undertake physically demanding manual work.
Ability to repeatedly lift, carry and stack timber products.
Commitment to workplace health and safety.
Ability to work effectively within a team environment.
Good communication skills.
Ability to follow instructions and established work procedures.
Desirable Skills
Previous experience within timber manufacturing, pallet repair, warehousing, manufacturing or general labouring.
Experience using hand and power tools.
Current Forklift Licence (LF).
Experience working within a production or manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

Applicants must be capable of:

Standing and walking for extended periods.
Frequent bending, twisting and reaching.
Repetitive lifting and carrying of timber products.
Performing physically demanding manual tasks.
Working around machinery and mobile plant.
Wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
3.3.6 Hours of Work, Pay & Conditions
Hours of Work

Successful applicants will generally work:

Monday to Friday
Full-Time – 38 ordinary hours per week
Ordinary hours will generally be worked between 7:30 am and 4:00 pm
30-minute unpaid meal break

Reasonable overtime may be required to meet operational requirements and will be paid in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Pay & Conditions

Employment conditions are governed by the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Successful applicants will receive:

Minimum full-time hourly rate of $26.44 per hour, plus applicable overtime, penalty rates and allowances in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
Annual leave, personal/carer's leave and other leave entitlements in accordance with the National Employment Standards.
Superannuation in accordance with the Superannuation Guarantee legislation.
Weekly payroll with itemised payslips.
Overtime and penalty rates where applicable under the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
Work Environment

This position is based within a timber processing and pallet manufacturing facility and involves:

Manual handling of timber products and pallets.
Repetitive lifting, carrying and stacking.
Standing and walking for extended periods.
Exposure to timber dust, noise and moving machinery.
Working indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Strict adherence to workplace health and safety procedures.
Wearing mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants must be able to:

Pass a pre-employment medical assessment.
Pass drug and alcohol screening.
Participate in a site safety induction.
Comply with all workplace health and safety policies and procedures.
Be physically capable of performing the inherent requirements of the position.
Training

Successful applicants will receive:

Full site induction.
On-the-job training.
Ongoing supervision and support.
Workplace health and safety training.
Instruction in the safe use of hand and power tools.
Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Applications are encouraged from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, cultural background or previous experience. Selection will be based on merit, skills, experience and the applicant's ability to perform the inherent requirements of the role.

How to Apply

Applicants should submit a current resume outlining their employment history, relevant experience and qualifications.

Applications will be assessed as they are received, with only shortlisted applicants contacted.

Generators Australia is a leading supplier of Solar and Hybrid Lighting Towers, Hybrid and Diesel Generators, Mobile AC Batteries, Solar CCTV and Diesel Compressors. Our core business facilitates the rental and capital sales of these products across Australia.
Generators Australia's incorporation of ground-breaking technology in renewable products utilising Lithium and Solar provide value-based solutions across a wide range of Industries, including Construction, Rail, Civil Infrastructure and Mining.
We believe in creating a welcoming culture which is centered around our company values - People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement.
Our growth in Solar/Hybrid Lighting and Power products across Australia has continued to exceed expectations, so we are now looking for a qualified Electrician with some experience in working with solar to join our St Marys team.
This role is full-time and will be paying between $110,000.00 and $130,000.00 per annum.
Other responsibilities will include:
•	Maintaining our Hybrid, Solar and Diesel-Powered assets
•	Test and Tagging of all equipment and other assets
•	Minor electrical Installations
•	Overall technical electrical support
•	Responsible for performing scheduled and breakdown electrical and mechanical maintenance on our fleet of equipment.
•	Diagnosing and rectifying electrical issues on all assets
•	Where required, undertake mechanical maintenance and repairs
•	Maintaining a strong safety focus.
•	Hours will be 7am to 5pm. Monday to Friday.
The successful candidate will be an individual who will honour our core value of People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement - in addition to this they will have:
•	Qualified Electrician with a recognised electrical trade qualification and the ability to obtain the required Australian electrical licence.
•	Valid Driver's License.
•	Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Tradesperson.
•	Ability to carry out basic electrical fault diagnosis and rectification.
•	Experience in electrical installation and commissioning, servicing, periodical inspections, preventative maintenance, and repairs to Generators Australia's equipment to meet both manufacture and company standards.
•	Experience working with Batteries, Inverters, Solar systems, EV Chargers and Diesel Engines
•	Ability to travel to East coast branches to provide overall technical support when required
•	Strong communication skills.
The Benefits of Joining Generators Australia
•	A competitive remuneration package aligned with your experience and qualifications.
•	Fully maintained company vehicle, fuel card, laptop and mobile phone.
•	The opportunity to work for a well-established and secure organisation.
•	On-going training and development
•	Inspirational leadership that is eager to help you succeed.
•	Employee Reward & Recognition programs to celebrate your successes.
•	Company Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental health.
•	A positive workplace with an ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and development
•	A safe workplace with a strong focus on ZERO harm - Every day
How to Apply
This is a great opportunity to work in a progressive and dynamic team within a secure and stable industry. If you feel that you have the experience, ability, and skills, we want to hear from you!
Click "Apply Now" and upload an updated copy of your resume and cover letter.
At Generators Australia, we recognize that we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and encourage women and Indigenous candidates to apply.
